raw_mass.name: Raw mass
raw_mass.line: Returned mass. Smelt it into aluminum, or Make a core, a probe, or a shuttle from it.

nickel_cinder.name: Nickel cinder
nickel_cinder.line: Cut from Cinder Reach. Bright seams in dark stone. Smelt it into aluminum or steel.

ice_spall.name: Ice spall
ice_spall.line: Chips off the Aegis ice. Cold, pale, and leased. Smelt it into an aluminum bar.

copper_slag.name: Copper slag
copper_slag.line: Green slag with a copper heart. Pair it with a bar to Make a gun or a Dart.

hull_plate.name: Hull plate
hull_plate.line: Torn plate from a broken hull. Smelt it into steel, or Make a tender from it.

salvage_parts.name: Keel salvage
salvage_parts.line: Stripped fittings. The tender brings these home. Smelt them into steel.

aluminum_bar.name: Aluminum bar
aluminum_bar.line: Smelted ice, nickel, and mass. Make a Dart, Sting, or fighter from it. Fleet ships only — not the keel.

steel_bar.name: Steel bar
steel_bar.line: Smelted nickel, plate, and salvage. Make a gun, belt, or rack from it.
